name: Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)
summary: Learn a generative distribution by adversarially training a generator and a discriminator.
summary_zh: 通过生成器与判别器的对抗优化学习数据分布。
core_idea: Minimize an adversarial two-player objective instead of an explicit normalized likelihood.
innovation: Provides a flexible implicit generative prior that can represent complicated data manifolds.
limitations: Training stability and mode collapse remain challenges.
Sample quality does not imply physics preservation or posterior calibration.

start_here.why: Foundational adversarial generative-model proposal and training objective.
start_here.focus: Adversarial game, generator/discriminator roles and limitations.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
